title: Snake Garden
pitch: A bright garden snake game where small challenges teach routing before an endless score chase.
capabilities: Fixed grid tick with smooth visual interpolation
Input buffering and responsive sound cues
rules: One cell per logical move; at most one queued turn per tick; direct reversal is invalid.
Food spawns only in empty cells. Collision with the tail cell is allowed only when the tail moves away on that same non-growth tick.
Campaign goals are collect-count challenges; a full board is victory, not an infinite food-spawn loop.
content: Six compact gardens, Classic endless and three fixed movement speeds.

actions.phone: D-pad or optional swipe; same command queue
actions.xr: Not applicable; plays as a flat browser app.
Not applicable; plays as a flat browser app.

rive.role: Animated seedling guide in title/results, with non-blocking score feedback.

polish: Soft corners and readable head direction
Optional swipe is supplemental, not the only phone control
tests: Tail-cell entry and growth are tested separately.
Two fast turns cannot reverse within one tick.
Food never appears in a wall.
RNG and input buffer round-trip in a save.
Resize cannot alter board dimensions or snake speed.

evaluate collision with the correct vacating-tail rule
